content:
Samir: Heads up — after merge 0c9a3f into main we see regressed p95 on int8 workload (translation) on canary.
Samir: Baselines: v0.31 p95=48ms, canary v0.32 p95=54–55ms, tail up ~12%.
Maya: Definitely seeing it on canary-uk-1. Quick run shows token generation CPU time increased in 'quant_unpack' hot path.
Anika: I ran perf and flamegraphs — hot loop spends a lot more time in memmove/memcpy inside the pack->unpack transition.
Samir: Not dequant math; it's the pack/unpack glue that was touched by merge 0c9a3f (kernel selector refactor).
Liam: Doing a bisect now; initial bisect points to commit 0c9a3f -> changes kernel selection order and inserts an unpack+reorder for INT8 BF16 fallback.
Infra-bot: CI perf job #9832 failed: p95 increase 11% (compare to baseline 0.31). Link: https://ci.redwood/9832
Maya: Quick local microbenchmark: replace memcpy with vectorized copy reduces p95 by ~6%. I'll push a patch.
Anika: Flamegraph snippet (relevant):
```
quant_unpack_loop()
  -> memmove
  -> reorder_bytes
  -> kv_cache_apply
```
Maya: Also noticing more cache-miss counters in perf (L1d misses up ~30%). Might be different memory layout after reorder.
Samir: Option A: revert kernel selector reorder (big hammer). Option B: patch memcpy->simd memcopy + adjust reorder placement.
Liam: Can we do a narrow revert for the reorder insertion only? That should be safe for canary.
Maya: I'll open a PR with SIMDCopy + tests, and a separate revert PR as fallback.
Ops-bot: Canary rollout paused for model-pool int8 due to perf alert.
Anika: Also double-check KV cache interaction — the extra reorder may be invalidating prefetch hints.
Samir: Thanks — priority P0 for canary. Please post perf diffs and attach perf.data if you run bisect. :pray:
Liam: Bisect lands cleanly on 0c9a3f, creating minimal repro. Attaching bisect steps in PR.
Maya: PR 2115 created: 'simd-copy for quant_unpack + unit tests' — benchmark shows p95 back to 49ms in canary.
Samir: Nice. Ops-bot, can we resume canary with PR 2115 and keep fallback revert ready?
Ops-bot: Canary resume scheduled after CI perf passes. Job queued.
Infra-bot: CI perf job #9840 queued for PR 2115.
Maya: If CI green, we'll monitor for 24h then promote.
Liam: Filing a follow-up to add regression test in perf CI for pack/unpack hot path.
Samir: Great work team — this one was subtle (memory layout rather than math).
